name: Tasks
description: A Todoist-style task manager for Standard Notes: List / Board / Agenda / Calendar / Matrix / Focus / Plan / Insights views, due dates, priorities, tags, notes, subtasks, links, recurrence, dependencies, and a local Insights dashboard (Most Important Tasks, momentum & wins, life-balance domains, planning/throughput, procrastination radar) plus a 'Right now' time+energy filter. All data is stored inside the note and protected by Standard Notes' end-to-end encryption.
